comment: Nightly Boat measurements of main, run by run_probes.py on one default VM. A probe whose `requires` paths are absent at the commit is skipped, so a lane registers its probe here in the PR that adds the benchmark. `prepare` is untimed (builds); `run` is timed when `timed` names a metric, and any line it prints as `METRIC {json}` is recorded too (metric, value, unit, statistic, optional workload, samples, caveats).

probes.name: bench-forks
probes.caveats: BENCH-FORK-1, one run per night. In-memory page tier only: no durability (U4), cold object-storage reads (U7), multi-node or contention. Fork p99 is a CPU tail on 4 vCPUs.

probes.name: promoted-proof-gates
probes.prepare: export CI=true && python3 -m venv /tmp/probe-venv && /tmp/probe-venv/bin/pip install --quiet --disable-pip-version-check jsonschema==4.25.1 PyYAML==6.0.3 && export PATH=/tmp/probe-venv/bin:$PATH && scripts/bootstrap-verification-tools.sh && scripts/bootstrap-ontology-tools.sh && scripts/bootstrap-rust-extraction-tools.sh
probes.caveats: Wall time of the formal phase's proof run (core.sh formal) after its tool bootstraps, which are untimed; per-gate values are the script's own [pass] seconds (1 s resolution). One run on a default Boat VM; Rust builds inside the gate start cold.
